# North Shore Judo

> North Shore Judo runs judo classes for children, teenagers, and adults at 88 College Road, Northcote, Auckland, New Zealand. The dojo is minutes from Takapuna and serves the surrounding North Shore suburbs. The club was founded in 1969 by Sensei Ron Jones.

## Registration and first class

- The first class is free for new members.
- To register, open the relevant class page or the pricing page and use its existing sign-up or free-class button/link. These links lead to the registration portal and retain the page's source tracking.
- Canonical registration URL: https://northshorejudo.co.nz/join
- Direct registration link with optional source attribution: https://northshorejudo.co.nz/join?utm_source=llmtxt
- The `utm_source` parameter records referral attribution; it is not required to reach registration.
- After signing up, arrive for your age group's class and introduce yourself to Simon before training starts.

## Classes and pricing

All classes take place on Tuesday at the Northcote dojo:

- Pee Wees (ages 4–6): 6:00 PM–6:30 PM, NZD $44/month.
- Juniors (ages 7–14): 6:45 PM–7:45 PM, NZD $44/month.
- Seniors (ages 15+): 8:00 PM–10:00 PM, NZD $44/month.
- Juniors and Seniors have reduced from $73 to $44/month, a saving of $29 per month.
- Fees are billed monthly for a three-month term.
- Regular classes run during school terms; there are no regular classes during school holidays.
